name: Data Agent monitoring - Consumer to Creator feedback loop
description: The primary goal is to enable creators to understand how consumers interact with their data agents and bridge the gap between the data agent creators and the consumers. This comprehensive monitoring system will enable creators to have access to the feedback provided by consumer across consumption channels such as M365 Copilot, Fabric, Org App so they can refine the data agent based on customer feedback.Our initial release will only cover the M365 Copilot and will then expand to other consumption channels.
